task: Research the new features of the iOS 17 on Apple support and check its compatibility with the iPhone 12.
answer: Final Response: iOS 17 new features (per Apple Support article 'About iOS 17 Updates', https://support.apple.com/en-us/118723): StandBy mode; Contact Posters for Phone; NameDrop and AirDrop improvements; Live Voicemail; the Journal app; a smarter keyboard with improved autocorrect and predictive text; FaceTime audio/video messages and Message catch-up; interactive Home Screen widgets; Check In safety feature; Safari and Music upgrades including AirPlay in hotels. Compatibility (per Apple Support iPhone User Guide, iOS 17): iPhone 12 is listed among the iPhone models compatible with iOS 17 (iOS 17 supports iPhone XR / iPhone 12 and later), so the iPhone 12 IS compatible with iOS 17.
